result.rationale: The diff adds `if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw new HttpError(...)` in salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts. Fetch responses often have empty statusText (HTTP/2 mandates empty reason phrase), so valid 200 responses could throw a spurious 400, breaking Salesforce token refresh. This is a plausible, mechanism-verifiable correctness defect introduced by the diff; the code exists exactly as described.
